chosen_args.why_stop: Stopped because the deterministic industrial decision is stable under the stopping rule: candidate_13 is feasible and lowest cost among optimized plausible candidates; all other candidates are either optimized or screened by the declared lower-activity-and-higher-price rule; and the highest-activity nonwinner candidate_04 has completed parity and reachability analysis showing the required 201.2x intrinsic-activity improvement is unreachable on the frozen descriptor scaling manifold.

unresolved_decision_risk.deterministic_model_risk: Low. The only unscreened higher-activity candidates were optimized and both are more costly than candidate_13.
unresolved_decision_risk.screening_rule_risk: Low within the declared screening rule. Twelve candidates were not process-optimized because candidate_13 has both higher reference activity and lower metal price.
unresolved_decision_risk.edge_optimum_risk: Moderate but not decision-changing from available checks. candidate_13 is at the Tsep upper edge, while candidate_04 and candidate_05 are at the T upper edge. The full admissible window was used, so these are domain-limited optima, not missed interior optima.
unresolved_decision_risk.vessel_floor_risk: Low for the winner. candidate_04 and candidate_05 fall below the vessel-cost correlation floor and are clamped, but they remain more costly than candidate_13 even with this favorable floor treatment.

unresolved_decision_risk.parity_risk: Low. candidate_04 would need a 201.2x intrinsic-activity gain, while the frozen descriptor manifold offers only 1.09x at reference and 2.52x across process states.
